_comment: Control family -> risk domain map. SPEC G-60, FR-17. Attestation authority is derived from THE QUESTION BEING SIGNED, never from an objective the caller supplied — a permission check reading a value the requester chose is not a permission check. Validated on import: an UNMAPPED FAMILY FAILS THE BUILD rather than falling through to 'anyone may sign'. A generalist assessor (no risk domain) covers everything, so a question can never sit in a queue nobody reads.

Governance.because: accountability and decision records are owned by the governance office

HR.because: personnel screening is owned by human resources

review_rubric._comment: SPEC G-61, FR-38. A mechanical rubric over WHAT IS ON RECORD — never a model's confidence in its own output. Every criterion is a fact the reviewer can verify on the same screen. The band ORDERS THE QUEUE AND DOES NOTHING ELSE: it cannot gate, skip or pre-approve an attestation.

criteria.text: A Partial, No or N-A was recorded without a written note.
The answer has changed more than twice.
A Yes was recorded but its detail questions were left unanswered.
The question was handed to somebody else to answer.
The answer was drafted from a document and carries a verbatim quote.

review_rubric.disclaimer: This ordering is a triage aid over what is on record. It does not gate, skip or pre-approve any attestation — every visible answer still needs yours.
